name: path-array-simple
description: Ladder for the duplicate-along-path array feature (PARITY-DUP-PATH). Rungs: (1) seed an L-shaped plan polyline + a source chair in the livingDining room; (2) verify the Path array UI is hidden in Simple mode; (3) switch to Pro, expand the inspector, fire the Path array Go button, assert 4 collision-fitting copies are placed along the path with arc-length spacing + tangent yaw (the source-position copy is reported as not-fitting); (4) screenshot top + perspective; (5) mobile-viewport leg.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: seed-polyline-and-chair
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const id = s.addPolyline({ points: [[9.2,2.2],[11.6,2.2],[11.6,4.6]] }); window.__polyId = id; s.setItems([{ id: 'src-chair', defId: 'dining-chair', position: [9.2,2.2], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); })()

steps.name: verify-path-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.act-array--path')) throw new Error('Path array UI should be hidden in Simple mode but is visible'); console.log('PASS: path array hidden in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-path-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.act-array--path')) throw new Error('Path array UI (.act-array--path) should be visible in Pro mode but is not present'); console.log('PASS: path array visible in Pro mode'); })()

steps.name: apply-path-array
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.act-array--path .act-array-go'); if (!b) throw new Error('Path array Go button not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-placed
steps.failMessage: Expected at least 4 items after path array (source + 3 fitting copies)

steps.name: verify-tangent-yaw
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = s.items; const onX = items.filter(i => Math.abs(i.position[1] - 2.2) < 0.05 && Math.abs(i.rotation - Math.PI/2) < 0.01); const onZ = items.filter(i => Math.abs(i.position[0] - 11.6) < 0.05 && Math.abs(i.rotation - 0) < 0.01 && Math.abs(i.position[1] - 2.2) > 0.05); if (onX.length < 1 || onZ.length < 1) throw new Error('Expected tangent yaw to differ across the L bend; onX='+onX.length+' onZ='+onZ.length); console.log('PASS: tangent yaw correct across the bend'); })()
